paper_goal_alignment.question: Can a curated GitHub project-first public structured-data frame plausibly supply enough project-month observations for the intended Stata panel regression without resuming the old crawler?

source.source_semantics: OSS Compass README describes single-repositories as user-submitted analysis requests for single repositories; this is a curated candidate source, not independent proof that repository=project.

execution.workflow: OMOSSP R1D GitHub Project-First Panel Coverage Audit

reasons_final_not_locked: OSS Compass single-repository status is a curated submission category, not independent validation of the theoretical project unit.
Final project/software/canonical-repository curation has not yet been applied.
The minimum acceptable N for the planned Stata panel design has not yet been literature-grounded and frozen.
Formal outcome/focal-indicator/control variables are not yet frozen.

acquisition_decision.reason_not_pooling: No need to add cross-platform comparability risk merely to increase N while GitHub alone already yields 935 full-24-month candidates.

next_stage.title: Literature-Grounded Minimum Sample + Project-Unit Curation Decision Lock
objectives: Re-read the core full-text OSS/project-performance and panel-data studies.
Freeze the minimum and preferred project count for the Stata panel design, distinguishing clusters N from project-month NT.
Define prospective project/software/canonical-repository curation rules without using performance outcomes.
Apply attrition scenarios to the 935 full-24-month and 891 full-36-month GitHub candidate pools.
Decide whether GitHub-only remains sufficient after plausible curation loss.
Only if the lower-bound post-curation N falls below the literature-grounded minimum may additional structured sources or targeted API be reconsidered.
